Following 1 Esdras, Josephus places Zorobabel's return after the contest before Darius; 11.4.1: cedar brought to Joppa "for that was what Cyrus had commanded at first, and what was now done at the command of Darius"; 11.4.2: "in the second year of their coming to Jerusalem … they had laid its foundations on the first day of the second month"; the old men lamented the inferior temple
